evidence: Market news leading into May 10, 2022, reflects severe systemic pressure and negative momentum. The unravelling of Terra's UST stablecoin peg below $0.70 has catalyzed aggressive selling and forced deployment of Bitcoin reserves, triggering widespread cascading liquidations exceeding $300M in single-hour spans. Exchange inflows reached three-month highs indicating heightened intent to sell, while professional derivatives traders have turned defensive as BTC tests psychological support around $30,000. Although some whale accumulation and a 500 BTC purchase by El Salvador provide modest absorption, structural panic from the Terra ecosystem collapse heavily outweighs dip-buying in the immediate 24-hour horizon.
limitations: Filtered out long-term predictions (e.g., Brock Pierce $1M target, Cathie Wood macro commentary) as they do not offer actionable 24-hour direction.
Multiple reports concerning El Salvador's 500 BTC purchase were treated as a single unified signal.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
